title.zh: 将苏禄省卢克市镇卡伦东小学的名称变更为Hadji Maharaja Tawasil小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Karundong Elementary School in the Municipality of Luuk, Province of Sulu, to Hadji Maharaja Tawasil Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Karundong Elementary School in the Municipality of Luuk, Province of Sulu, to Hadji Maharaja Tawasil Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Karundong tại Thị trấn Luuk, Tỉnh Sulu thành Trường tiểu học Hadji Maharaja Tawasil
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Karundong ในเทศบาล Luuk, จังหวัด Sulu เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Hadji Maharaja Tawasil
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Karundong di Kotamadya Luuk, Provinsi Sulu menjadi Sekolah Dasar Hadji Maharaja Tawasil
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Karundong di Perbandaran Luuk, Wilayah Sulu menjadi Sekolah Rendah Hadji Maharaja Tawasil

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3915_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Karundong Elementary School in the Municipality of Luuk, Province of Sulu, is changed to Hadji Maharaja Tawasil Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
